na2ecd31285.headline: Kenya: Portland Cement Raises Blue Triangle Price Amid Rising Input Costs
na2ecd31285.summary: East African Portland Cement has raised the price of its Blue Triangle cement by Sh10 per bag. The company cites rising raw material costs.
na2ecd31285.why: East African Portland Cement is a major Kenyan cement producer. Cement prices feed into construction costs and housing and infrastructure budgets.

n49b0415694.headline: Watch: Moment Iranian 'suicide boat' struck US-owned tanker
n49b0415694.summary: Iran attacked the US-owned crude oil tanker Safesea Vishnu near Iraq's Basra, killing one Indian national, according to a published video. The Times of India reported the attack.
n49b0415694.why: Basra is a major Iraqi oil export hub, and tanker attacks in the Gulf can disrupt crude flows and raise shipping risk premiums.

nc1099b2538.headline: Budget Debate: We don’t support the $18 billion tax package, says Robinson - Jamaica Observer
nc1099b2538.summary: Opposition finance spokesman Julian Robinson said his party does not support the $18 billion tax package. He argued new taxes after Hurricane Melissa would raise grocery costs.
nc1099b2538.why: Budget tax measures shape fiscal balances, inflation and household spending, which matter for Jamaican sovereign and corporate credit.

nb3fe798b32.headline: Italian Insurer Generali Posts Rise in Profit -- Update
nb3fe798b32.summary: Assicurazioni Generali reported a rise in 2025 profit on the performance of all its business units. Results were broadly in line with market expectations.
nb3fe798b32.why: Generali is one of Europe's largest insurers, and its earnings reflect premium growth, investment returns and capital strength.

impacts.name: Assicurazioni Generali
impacts.why: Reported 2025 profit rose, with all business units contributing, in line with expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

neae36a270c.headline: All the ships attacked in the Gulf since the US-Israeli war on Iran began
neae36a270c.summary: Crew members have been killed and global shipping has been severely disrupted by attacks on vessels in the Gulf since the US-Israeli war on Iran began.
neae36a270c.why: Gulf waterways carry a large share of the world's seaborne oil and LNG, so attacks on shipping raise freight costs, insurance premiums and supply risk.
neae36a270c.why_moved: Attacks on vessels and severe shipping disruption in the Gulf raise concerns about supply through a key energy route.

ne6e32dcf6a.headline: How airlines have hedged against fuel price increases
ne6e32dcf6a.summary: Some airlines use futures and options to hedge fuel costs. US airlines, which abandoned hedging, could be hardest hit if the war is prolonged.
ne6e32dcf6a.why: Airlines are highly exposed to jet fuel costs, so hedging through derivatives is a common way to smooth earnings against price swings.

na8f0e1c163.headline: From Air India to Qantas: Airlines hiking fares as fuel prices soar amid US-Iran war | Full list
na8f0e1c163.summary: Airlines in Asia and Europe, including Air India and Qantas, are raising ticket prices and adding fuel surcharges amid volatile oil prices from the Iran war.
na8f0e1c163.why: Fuel is one of the largest costs for airlines, so surcharges and fare increases are their usual response to higher jet fuel prices.

impacts.name: Qantas
impacts.why: Fuel surcharges are being implemented to offset higher fuel costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n7ccda695c0.headline: Goldman Sachs' review of Greek banks concluded without surprises
n7ccda695c0.summary: A Goldman Sachs review of Greek banks concluded without surprises, with the Greek side highlighting a favourable macroeconomic backdrop and rising private consumption and investment.
n7ccda695c0.why: Greek banks' lending capacity depends on the domestic economy, and independent reviews by investment banks inform investor views on their health.

nc1432bd5e9.headline: First crude shipment reaches Mumbai port following tense Strait of Hormuz passage - BusinessToday
nc1432bd5e9.summary: A Liberian-flagged tanker, the Shenlong Suezmax, delivered its first crude shipment to Mumbai port after a tense passage through the Strait of Hormuz. The crude was loaded at Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura port.
nc1432bd5e9.why: Mumbai is one of India's main oil import hubs, and Ras Tanura is a major Saudi crude export terminal.

n9c753c566f.headline: Oil tops $100, gas prices climb by 55 cents amid Middle East violence
n9c753c566f.summary: Iranian attacks in the Gulf have halted oil flows, pushing crude past $100 and lifting U.S. gasoline prices by 54 cents in a month. The Middle East war is escalating.
n9c753c566f.why: Crude oil prices feed directly into fuel costs, inflation and corporate margins across the global economy. Brent is the main international benchmark.
n9c753c566f.why_moved: Iranian attacks on Gulf shipping have halted oil flow, according to the report, pushing crude above $100.

n18ea538536.headline: Sensex, Nifty end sharply lower as oil price volatility weighs on markets
n18ea538536.summary: Indian benchmark indices closed lower on March 12 as volatility in global oil prices dampened investor sentiment. Selling spread across sectors.
n18ea538536.why: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty 50 are India's two main benchmark equity indices, tracking large listed companies. Oil prices are a key input cost for the Indian economy.
n18ea538536.why_moved: Volatility in global oil prices dampened investor sentiment and triggered selling across sectors.

ncd1b651df5.headline: Iran conflict creating ‘largest oil supply disruption in history’, says IEA
ncd1b651df5.summary: The International Energy Agency said the Iran conflict is creating the largest oil supply disruption in history. Oil prices rose again as Iran continued strikes on key energy and shipping infrastructure in the Middle East.
ncd1b651df5.why: The IEA coordinates energy policy for major oil-consuming nations, and its supply assessments shape expectations for crude prices and emergency stock releases.
ncd1b651df5.why_moved: Iran's strikes on key energy and shipping infrastructure in the Middle East have disrupted supply, and oil prices rose again on the day. The IEA's assessment reinforces concerns about tight crude supply.

nfe45e0f151.headline: Sensex tumbles 2,171 pts, Nifty falls over 2% in 2 days; will stock market extend losses? - BusinessToday
nfe45e0f151.summary: The Sensex fell 2,171 points and the Nifty dropped over 2% in two sessions. Investors lost over Rs 6 lakh crore as BSE-listed market capitalisation declined to Rs 440.15 lakh crore.
nfe45e0f151.why: The Sensex and Nifty are India's benchmark equity indices, and their moves reflect sentiment across the country's large listed companies.
nfe45e0f151.why_moved: The Sensex and Nifty declined over two sessions, with broad market losses erasing investor wealth. The input does not specify a single trigger beyond the wider market weakness.

nbb9b37b9ac.headline: Countries scramble to shore up global oil supplies as ships are attacked
nbb9b37b9ac.summary: Countries are scrambling to shore up global oil supplies after ships were attacked. The report describes the disruption as a threat to global energy supply.
nbb9b37b9ac.why: Attacks on tankers in the Gulf region can tighten global crude supply and raise energy costs for importers.
nbb9b37b9ac.why_moved: Attacks on ships threaten global crude supply, prompting governments to seek alternative barrels.

n53d6be7627.headline: Medical device makers face cost squeeze as gas curbs and polymer prices surge - BusinessToday
n53d6be7627.summary: Medical device manufacturers are absorbing cost increases for now. Prolonged disruption in gas supplies and polymer prices could eventually force price revisions.
n53d6be7627.why: Medical device makers rely on petrochemical polymers and energy, so input-cost shocks flow into their margins.

n4914c396d5.headline: Petrol pumps run dry at Gull stations on discount day as motorists rush on cut-price fuel
n4914c396d5.summary: Auckland motorists were left frustrated when fuel ran out at Gull stations during a cut-price fuel day. The shortage came as drivers rushed to take advantage of the discount.
n4914c396d5.why: Gull is a New Zealand fuel retailer, and fuel supply is sensitive to global crude and refining disruptions.

n82c64ecb34.headline: Atlassian workers in shock after AI-related layoffs
n82c64ecb34.summary: Almost 500 Atlassian employees in Australia were told by email that their services are no longer required, in layoffs linked to AI.
n82c64ecb34.why: Atlassian is an Australian software company behind Jira and Confluence, and workforce changes signal how AI is reshaping its cost structure.

neeb6e0be72.headline: Pune: Panic Buying Of LPG Cylinders As Queues Stretch Over 1 km Amid West Asia War Concerns |VIDEO
neeb6e0be72.summary: Hundreds of customers queued outside gas agencies in Pune to buy LPG cylinders as households fear that supplies could be affected if the international situation worsens.
neeb6e0be72.why: LPG is a widely used household fuel in India, and India imports much of its supply, so Gulf tensions can affect domestic fuel availability.

nc56ff70db4.headline: Factbox: Iran war causes major oil, gas disruptions
nc56ff70db4.summary: The US-Israeli war on Iran and Tehran's attacks on Gulf neighbours have disrupted oil and natural gas exports from the Middle East and forced production changes.
nc56ff70db4.why: Middle East oil and LNG exports supply a large share of global energy, so disruptions feed directly into crude, gas and fuel prices.

n27c24df02e.headline: Iran says its new leader made his 1st address, vowing to keep Strait of Hormuz closed
n27c24df02e.summary: Iran's state media issued a statement attributed to Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei vowing to keep the Strait of Hormuz closed. It also pledged to keep up attacks on US bases in the region.
n27c24df02e.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint through which a large share of seaborne oil passes, so closures directly affect global crude supply.
n27c24df02e.why_moved: A stated commitment to keep the Strait of Hormuz closed threatens oil flows through a key chokepoint, supporting crude prices.

n085d816ecd.headline: Pimpri-Chinchwad Police Keep Watch On Illegal Gas Refilling Amidst Panic Buying Due To West Asia Tensions
n085d816ecd.summary: Pimpri-Chinchwad police are watching for illegal refilling of commercial gas cylinders from domestic ones. Commercial gas is unavailable amid panic buying linked to West Asia tensions.
n085d816ecd.why: Liquefied petroleum gas supply in India depends heavily on imports, so Middle East disruptions can quickly affect domestic and commercial fuel availability.

nc44404ac3f.headline: India’s Retail Inflation Rises To 3.21% In February, Up From 2.74% In January Under New CPI Series
nc44404ac3f.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 3.21% in February from 2.74% in January under the new CPI series with 2024 as base year, though vegetable prices fell sharply.
nc44404ac3f.why: Consumer price inflation guides the Reserve Bank of India's interest-rate decisions and shapes expectations for Indian bond yields and the rupee.

ndf482908ef.headline: World faces largest-ever oil supply disruption on Middle East war, IEA says
ndf482908ef.summary: The International Energy Agency said the war in the Middle East is creating the biggest oil supply disruption on record. It followed an agreement to release a record volume from strategic stockpiles.
ndf482908ef.why: The IEA coordinates energy policy among major oil-consuming countries and monitors global oil supply. Supply shocks feed directly into crude prices, inflation and corporate costs.
ndf482908ef.why_moved: Supply is expected to fall sharply due to the war, and the IEA's record stockpile release was announced to offset shortages and a price spike.

n0e1631cd93.headline: 'No shortage of petrol, diesel, ATF': Hardeep Puri in Parliament amid LPG cylinder shortage - BusinessToday
n0e1631cd93.summary: Minister Hardeep Puri told Parliament there is no shortage of petrol, diesel or ATF, saying LPG panic was driven by consumer anxiety rather than an actual supply gap.
n0e1631cd93.why: Energy supply reassurances from the government affect consumer behaviour and the fuel retail and LPG distribution sectors.

n5c4fd737c2.headline: Major Tasmanian food company goes into voluntary administration
n5c4fd737c2.summary: Tasmanian agrifood business TasFoods has gone into voluntary administration, with an oversupply of chicken meat blamed for the collapse.
n5c4fd737c2.why: Poultry processing margins are sensitive to supply gluts, and administration can affect suppliers and creditors.

n524bc82a9e.headline: Beijing rejects Sinopec's request to tap commercial reserve, sources say
n524bc82a9e.summary: China has rejected a request by refiner Sinopec to access 13 million metric tons of national commercial reserves to offset an expected supply gap. The gap is linked to the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran.
n524bc82a9e.why: Sinopec is one of China's largest refiners and crude processors, so its feedstock supply shapes Chinese fuel output and regional crude demand. Commercial reserves are stockpiles that can cushion supply disruptions.

nb662626d77.headline: Oil wreaks havoc – North American Session Market Wrap for March 12
nb662626d77.summary: Oil shook up markets after a calmer start to the week, according to a North American session recap for March 12, 2026. The report does not detail specific price levels.
nb662626d77.why: Oil price swings feed into inflation expectations, energy company earnings and broader equity market sentiment.
nb662626d77.why_moved: Oil prices moved sharply after a quieter start to the week, driving broader market swings.

n4d710d0aca.headline: Australian Petrol Prices Set To Skyrocket After Strikes In Strait Of Hormuz Amid Iran, Israel, US Conflict
n4d710d0aca.summary: Australians are being warned to brace for higher petrol prices as attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz choke global oil supplies. The warning covers domestic fuel costs.
n4d710d0aca.why: Petrol prices feed directly into Australian consumer inflation and household budgets, and shape the Reserve Bank of Australia's policy outlook.

ned61214038.headline: Nation cracks down on vehicles illegally being sent to Russia
ned61214038.summary: Tens of thousands of cars are being exported from China to Russia under grey-market schemes, and authorities are cracking down on the practice. The report describes the scale of the trade.
ned61214038.why: China is a major car exporter, and sanctions-related trade flows affect automakers, exporters and Russian import supply.

ne1878768c5.headline: Alchip Reports ASIC-Leading 2nm Developments
ne1878768c5.summary: Alchip reports developments in its 2nm test chip, which targets a gate-level design for application-specific integrated circuits.
ne1878768c5.why: Alchip is a Taiwanese chip design firm supplying custom AI and computing chips, so its advanced-node progress matters for the semiconductor supply chain.

n08ad73d915.headline: Business groups want flexible four-day workweek policy
n08ad73d915.summary: Business groups in Cebu support making the proposed four-day workweek optional rather than mandatory, echoing national business leaders.
n08ad73d915.why: Mandatory workweek rules would change labor costs and productivity planning for employers in the Philippines.

n6a36c11f76.headline: IMF assures continued support for Bangladesh
n6a36c11f76.summary: The IMF assured continued support for Bangladesh, which remains under a $5.5 billion loan programme. The programme is ongoing.
n6a36c11f76.why: The IMF provides financing and policy support to countries facing balance-of-payments pressure, which affects sovereign creditworthiness and reforms.

n59f150843c.headline: Oil tankers burn as Iranian strikes defy Trump's claim to have won the war
n59f150843c.summary: Two tankers were ablaze in an Iraqi port after a hit by suspected Iranian explosive-laden boats, Reuters reports, as Iranian strikes continue.
n59f150843c.why: Iraq's southern ports handle large volumes of crude exports, so attacks there can disrupt global oil supply.
n59f150843c.why_moved: Attacks on tankers at an oil export port raise supply disruption risks, supporting crude prices.

n128918ff06.headline: Six vessels attacked in Gulf, Strait of Hormuz
n128918ff06.summary: Two fuel tankers were set alight in Iraqi waters in a deadly attack that appears to mark a wider campaign. Six vessels have been attacked in the Gulf and Strait of Hormuz.
n128918ff06.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint for global oil and LNG shipments, so attacks there affect energy supply and freight costs.
n128918ff06.why_moved: Attacks on fuel tankers and shipping in the Gulf raise supply disruption risk for oil flows.

na812dff3f4.headline: Merchant ships caught in widening Gulf attacks
na812dff3f4.summary: Merchant vessels have been caught up in widening attacks in the Gulf region. The report does not detail the scale of the damage.
na812dff3f4.why: Commercial shipping through Gulf waters carries much of the world's oil and container trade, so attacks raise freight and insurance costs.

n83508b254e.headline: China slams Trump's trade investigation, as it approves a 5-year economic plan
n83508b254e.summary: China's Foreign Ministry criticized the Trump administration's trade investigation as a pretext for tariffs, while China advanced a five-year plan that may rankle trade partners.
n83508b254e.why: US trade investigations can lead to tariffs on Chinese goods, which affects global supply chains and trade-exposed companies.

n0c36fb43b4.headline: Iran says its new leader made his 1st address, vowing to keep Strait of Hormuz closed
n0c36fb43b4.summary: Iranian state media issued a statement attributed to Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei vowing to keep the Strait of Hormuz closed. It also pledged continued attacks on U.S. bases in the region.
n0c36fb43b4.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint through which a large share of the world's seaborne oil passes. Any disruption there directly affects global energy supply and prices.

source.name: WKU Public Radio | The Public Radio Service of Western Kentucky University

sources.name: WKU Public Radio | The Public Radio Service of Western Kentucky University

n0c36fb43b4.why_moved: The statement vows to keep the strait closed and maintain attacks on U.S. bases, prolonging supply disruption risk for oil.

nc3bfd48939.headline: Metaplanet Expands Bitcoin Strategy with New Venture Firm
nc3bfd48939.summary: Metaplanet has formed a new venture company to support local Bitcoin infrastructure projects in Japan, with an estimated $25 million in support over the first two to three years.
nc3bfd48939.why: Metaplanet is a Tokyo-listed company that holds Bitcoin as a treasury asset, so its funding decisions affect its exposure to the cryptocurrency.

n9efea2641f.headline: TotalEnergies says it will lose 15% of global production due to shutdowns in Middle East
n9efea2641f.summary: TotalEnergies said it will lose 15% of its global production due to shutdowns affecting Qatar, Iraq and the UAE. It expects higher oil prices to compensate for the lost output.
n9efea2641f.why: TotalEnergies is a major French integrated oil and gas company with large production interests in the Middle East.

impacts.name: TotalEnergies
impacts.why: Losing 15% of global output reduces volumes, though the company expects higher oil prices to offset it.

n35a983030a.headline: Nedbank, Crypto.com to Bring Blockchain Payments Across Africa : TechMoran
n35a983030a.summary: Nedbank Group has entered a partnership with Crypto.com to explore blockchain-based payment, settlement and liquidity solutions across Africa.
n35a983030a.why: Nedbank is a major South African bank, and Crypto.com is a global crypto platform. Bank-crypto partnerships signal how traditional lenders are testing digital payment rails.

n7023cf0eca.headline: 1st week of Iran war cost US over $11 billion, Pentagon estimates
n7023cf0eca.summary: The first week of the war in Iran has cost the United States over $11 billion, according to Pentagon estimates given to Congress in a closed-door briefing.
n7023cf0eca.why: Large defense outlays affect federal budget deficits and can shift government spending priorities.

nc9125ae221.headline: Autonomous A2Z completes W40.5b funding, gears up for IPO this year
nc9125ae221.summary: Autonomous A2Z said it completed a 40.5 billion won ($27.4 million) pre-IPO funding round, bringing total funding to 122.5 billion won. It is preparing for an IPO this year.
nc9125ae221.why: Pre-IPO rounds set valuation expectations ahead of public listings, which matter to investors watching Korea's tech pipeline.

n0f79f10ea7.headline: Kyushu And India Chambers Sign MoU To Expand Business Ties
n0f79f10ea7.summary: The Dow dropped 400 points after trimming an early plunge of 1,200 points, as oil prices climbed higher. Stocks had opened sharply lower before the recovery.
n0f79f10ea7.why: The Dow Jones Industrial Average tracks 30 large US companies and is a widely followed barometer of US equity sentiment.
n0f79f10ea7.why_moved: Stocks opened with a sharp early plunge as oil prices climbed higher amid the Iran conflict, then partly recovered before closing lower.

nbf0c42544a.headline: Experts urge caution over limiting fuel purchase
nbf0c42544a.summary: Economists have urged caution over proposals to limit RON95 petrol purchases for Malaysians following the Iran-US conflict. They warn of panic buying and supply distortions.
nbf0c42544a.why: Fuel subsidy and purchase rules affect Malaysia's inflation, government spending and fuel supply chains.

nd389e7256b.headline: RON95 stays at RM1.99 under Budi95
nd389e7256b.summary: The price of RON95 petrol under the Budi95 targeted fuel subsidy mechanism will remain at RM1.99 per litre, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said.
nd389e7256b.why: Fuel subsidies shape Malaysia's inflation outlook and government fiscal spending.
